INSERT INTO workspace_diff (source_workspace_id, fork_workspace_id, path, kind, ahead, behind, has_changes, fork_last_event_kind, fork_last_event_origin)
                VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 1, 0, NULL, $5, $6)
                ON CONFLICT (source_workspace_id, fork_workspace_id, path, kind)
                DO UPDATE SET
                    ahead = workspace_diff.ahead + 1,
                    has_changes = NULL,
                    fork_last_event_kind = CASE WHEN $6::varchar IS NULL OR (NOT $7 AND workspace_diff.fork_last_event_origin IS NOT NULL) THEN workspace_diff.fork_last_event_kind ELSE $5 END,
                    fork_last_event_origin = CASE WHEN $6::varchar IS NULL OR (NOT $7 AND workspace_diff.fork_last_event_origin IS NOT NULL) THEN workspace_diff.fork_last_event_origin ELSE $6 END
